text.title: Go Backend Development Patterns Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Go Backend Development Patterns artefact from typed inputs, plus a 6-step scaffold sub-procedure for when the artefact is a new service.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `gobe-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/go-backend.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Scaffold sub-procedure (expands steps 3 and 5 when the artefact is a new service)

step.name: bootstrap-module
step.decision-gate: If the module path collides with internal/ imports from another repo (monorepo path), stop and reconsider layout.

step.name: declare-errors-and-middleware
step.input: List of error classes (NotFound, BadRequest, Conflict, Internal).
step.action: Drop in `templates/app-error.go`; wire the ErrorHandler middleware in `internal/middleware/error.go`.
step.decision-gate: If the team already uses a different error type, adapt the middleware to its sentinel/wrapper but keep exactly ONE mapping point.

step.name: wire-router-and-server
step.action: Create `internal/server/server.go` with `Wire(cfg) *http.Server`; main.go only calls Wire + ListenAndServe with graceful shutdown.
step.decision-gate: Run `wc -l cmd/api/main.go`; if over 50 lines, refactor before continuing.

step.name: define-consumer-interfaces
step.action: Declare interfaces (UserRepository, OrderRepository) inside `internal/service/`; implement them in `internal/repository/`. service MUST NOT import repository.
step.output: All interface declarations live in `internal/service/*.go`; `repository/*.go` imports `model` only.
step.decision-gate: `go vet ./...` plus a grep for `type \w+ interface` under `repository/`.

step.name: add-worker-pool-if-needed
step.action: Create `internal/concurrency/pool.go` with a Pool struct, jobs buffer = `runtime.NumCPU()*2`, and Submit selecting on `ctx.Done()`.

step.name: audit
step.output: Layout report; zero violations means the checklist passed.
step.decision-gate: Block the commit if external-internal imports are found or any forbidden pattern is detected.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
